title: Protocolo para PFA 4%
author: Hector Silva
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bcjaiuie

steps.title: Prepare PFA solution
steps.instruction: Heat distilled water to 70°C in a mixer, add a stir bar (magnet), and turn it on, gradually adding the PFA.

steps.title: Homogenize and buffer the mixture
steps.instruction: Add NaOH pellets until the mixture becomes clear and homogeneous, then add 0.2M PB solution.

substeps.instruction: Add two or more pellets of NaOH until the mixture is clear and homogeneous
